rule.basis: committed files only: the programs each college's capture listed (the gap census's committed universe)
rule.passing: coverage and invented true, arithmetic equal or unstated (the Program Requirements tab's own test)
rule.overall: catalog source + program requirements passing + (SLOs + PLOs) / 2, divided by 3 (the whole-harvest rule), from the live counts (key overall, basis live); unread parts count as zero
rule.confidence: strong = 5 or more spot-checked records at the college, all agreeing; partial = 5 or more checked with one differing, or 5 agree beside an unreachable page; limited = machine checks only, fewer than 5 checked whatever they found (a cross-college check), or 2 or more differ (display held). An unreachable page is not a checked record; the newest receipt by checked_at counts, and on a tie the receipt with the later source comment (kb/spot_checks/README.md)

causes.not_in_capture: program not in the college's capture
causes.no_closed_list: no closed list in the Program Course File
causes.places_none: extracted, places none of its courses
causes.unknown_without_live: filed record fails, live state unknown

unpark.what: a session takes the parked college back up under its decision

first_read.what: a first read of a college never read (capture free, extraction paid)

capture_and_read.what: a fresh capture lists the program, then its extraction

capture_rerun_closed_list_now_filed.what: the Program Course File now lists its courses: a fresh capture, then extraction

program_course_file_refresh.what: the Program Course File lists no course for it: program-course-fetch.yml, or none exists

program_course_file_check.what: check the Program Course File for its courses (needs the live read)

reader_page_search.what: a reader change finds the program's page (a free page read first)

paid_read.what: extraction of a page the capture already found

reader_page_assignment.what: a reader change hands it its own page, then extraction

load.what: step=load: the filed record passes and was never loaded

reconcile_then_load.what: the filed record fails: reconcile steps, then step=load

reread.what: step=reread: the filed record passes and the live row is older

ge_units_steps.what: reconcile steps give the general education pattern its units

scorer_noncredit_hours.what: a scorer reading for a noncredit total in hours

reconcile_steps.what: the college's reconcile steps, on the catalog's own words

tba.overall: The overall bar averages catalog source, program requirements and outcomes (SLOs and PLOs averaged), from live counts per college. It waits on the first live read of the census workflow.
tba.teachout_approved: Teachout and Approved programs are counted apart from Active in the live COCI table; the counts wait on the first live read of the census workflow.
tba.apis: The checklist is filed in the data dictionary; this tile shows it in the next slice of the page.
tba.jst: The JST funnel waits on an authorized-student feed from CCCStart; counts only, when it exists.
tba.plo: Program outcomes are filed with each committed program record (record.program.outcomes in kb/program_requirements_college/<slug>/records/), not yet read per college here.
tba.catalog_registry: The catalog link, curriculum view and program map checks are rows in the live program source registry, which this file does not carry.
tba.ppm: Program Pathways Mapper has no official export; 4 pilot term maps are committed (kb/program_requirements_pilot/sequences/), not yet read per college here.
tba.descriptions: Usable course descriptions per college come from the description classifier (#3219), whose counts are not a committed file yet.
tba.cpl: MAP exhibits per college are a live sync, and no completeness denominator for CPL is defined yet.
tba.mis: The Fall 2025 MIS course file is committed but not yet joined to each college here.
tba.coe: The regional labor market crosswalk (kb/regional_cpl_out/) is committed but not yet read per college here.
tba.loaded: The load time and a person's confirmation are columns of the live program requirements table, which this file does not carry.
tba.owners: The gap census names the change that would move each program, not who makes it; an owner joins each ask when the asks are filed with one.
tba.slo: Course SLO reads are committed for 12 hosts under kb/course_outcomes/<host>/, not yet read per college here; the SLO queue's state shows where the queue holds a college.
tba.objectives: Course objectives are committed for 4 hosts (ccc, cccd, cuesta, shasta) under kb/course_outcomes/<host>/, not yet read per college here.

datasets.name: Program requirements
datasets.owner: The college (catalog owner: curriculum office). COBI holds a read copy; COCI (CCCCO) is the program list of record.
datasets.procedure_today: A catalog reader per platform (CourseLeaf, Acalog, PDF and others) in GitHub Actions; filed to `kb/program_requirements_college/<slug>/`, loaded to `program_requirement_records`. The live counts per college (Active, Teachout and Approved apart) come from `kb/_commons_data_live.py`, run by the `live-counts` job of `harvest-gap-census.yml` on main alone, in the `live-counts` GitHub environment that holds the service key (restricted to main; Sam, 2026-11-13, on COBIx's recommendation); it hands the census job one artifact of counts.
datasets.planned_improvement: One matrix run per wave with per-college receipts; v2 automatic reread after verify; spot-check 5 records per college; platform readers before PDF extraction.

datasets.name: Course SLOs
datasets.owner: The college (SLO coordinator, curriculum office). Systems: eLumen, CurriQunet/Meta, Coursedog and others.
datasets.procedure_today: The course-outline reader writes `kb/course_outcomes/<slug>/read_<run>_pNofM.json`, and `course_outcomes_load()` loads it (insert-only, service role).
datasets.planned_improvement: Parser fixes for the parser colleges; feed derived descriptions (#3219); spot-check outcomes against the outline.

datasets.name: Program PLOs
datasets.procedure_today: The same catalog reader as program requirements; the outcomes sit inside the record.
datasets.planned_improvement: A separate PLO completeness check; spot-check with the program record.

datasets.name: Course objectives
datasets.procedure_today: The course-outline reader; `kb/_course_outcomes_load.py` adds them with kind `objective`.
datasets.planned_improvement: Read objectives in the same pass as SLOs; per-college parser status in `queue.json`.

datasets.name: Course descriptions
datasets.owner: CCCCO (COCI, the Chancellor's Office Curriculum Inventory); each college's curriculum office enters the content. A vendor operates COCI for the CO (*to confirm*).
datasets.procedure_today: The COCI course list export saved to `kb/reference/coci_course_list.xlsx`; WestEd holds the current COCI (the partner exchange). The snapshot's date is May 21, 2026, from the committed export itself (its sheet is named "20260521 Course List from MAP C", and the file was created and saved that day). The register's WestEd entry calls our COCI copy July's, which may be another copy; the conflict stays open (*to confirm*).
datasets.planned_improvement: A scheduled COCI pull (API *to confirm*); dedupe double-listed institutions; type untyped rows from MIS; derived descriptions with provenance (#3219).
evidence_cited: docs/reference/data_sources.md

datasets.name: CPL / MAP
datasets.owner: MAP (RCCD / InfoTech), the system of record for CPL; colleges enter exhibits.
datasets.procedure_today: The daily build fetches the MAP CustomReport with the MAP API key (`scripts/daily_build.sh`, run by `daily-dashboard.yml`); `chatbox/sync_chatbox_exhibits.py` stages it in `stg_chatbox_exhibits`, and `chatbox_exhibits_promote()` replaces `chatbox_exhibits` in one transaction.
datasets.planned_improvement: Define the CPL completeness denominator (Sam); match exhibits to COBI courses on every target course.

datasets.name: Catalog source
datasets.procedure_today: The census workflow writes `program_source_registry` through its definer function; the live export reads whether a catalog link, a curriculum view and a sequence source are held, as counts.
datasets.planned_improvement: Flag changed catalog years automatically. The draft's "census on a schedule" is already true: the census runs weekly.

datasets.planned_improvement: Ask the Foundation and Concentric Sky for an export or read access (the October 17 note, not recorded as sent); or receive maps through Common Cloud.

datasets.name: CCCStart (formerly CCCApply): student ID and info layer
datasets.owner: CCCCO (the Reimagine Apply initiative); operated by the CCC Technology Center (steward *to confirm*). Students own their application data; each college is the FERPA custodian of its student records.
datasets.procedure_today: Not yet. Today's student-ID paths into MAP: JST parsing, Credit for Being You import, manual entry by college staff, batch upload. The API would remove re-keying, JST parse errors, duplicate or inconsistent MAP Student IDs, and batch lag.
datasets.planned_improvement: Ask the CO and the Technology Center for a CCCStart API or event feed for MAP (ID match, the military and JST opt-in); confirm the steward; get the CCCStart data dictionary; record each college's cutover date.
evidence_cited: docs/reference/data_sources.md::### CCCStart

datasets.name: JST authorizations
datasets.owner: The field: CCCCO (CCCApply and CCCStart, operated by the CCC Technology Center; CCCStart steward *to confirm*). The transcript: the U.S. Department of Defense JST office (jst.doded.mil). The records: the college (FERPA custodian); CPL decisions in MAP.
datasets.procedure_today: By hand: staff must know the field exists, run a CCCApply Report Center report (or query the SIS staging table) for opt-in = T, request each JST through the JST site (institutional request mechanics *to confirm*), wait for the transcript; then an evaluator reviews it for ACE recommendations and faculty decide CPL in MAP. Many colleges never pull the list. In June 2026 the CPL Initiative asked RAD for the opted-in students; the request now waits on the CO General Counsel's procedural OK (the register's JST entry).
datasets.planned_improvement: The top ask: an authorized-student feed per college from CCCStart, then a system-level JST request and receipt path into MAP per college, then an evaluator queue; publish a one-page "where to find your list" guide for colleges; add CCCStart's field here once it is published.
